rows.grounds: compound of veda, sarvasva, and bhūta meaning consisting of the essence of the Vedas
refers to the names mentioned previously
demonstrative pointing to the specified names

items.question: What constitutes the true essential nature of these divine names?
premises: These specific names are the subject of identification.
They consist of the entire essence of the Vedas.
This characterization holds in ultimate reality.
items.inference: Therefore, these names are in reality the very essence of the Vedas.
items.plain_english: In reality, these names consist of the very essence of the Vedas.
